metadata.description: Demo plugin marketplace for the GitHub Copilot Lab. Contains example plugins showcasing agents, skills, and the plugin distribution system.

plugins.name: alert-toolkit
plugins.description: Alert analysis and triage tools for security event management. Includes an alert analyst agent and a triage skill for prioritizing incidents.

plugins.name: code-reviewer
plugins.description: Automated code review assistant with structured feedback and language-specific checklists. Catches bugs, security issues, and best practice violations.

plugins.name: learning-companion
plugins.description: Interactive learning companion for GitHub Copilot features. Provides guided tutoring and generates practice exercises for completions, inline chat, agents, and more.
